description: Source code for a CoAP server test implementation in Zephyr RTOS, defining resource handlers for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and wildcard resources.

methods.name: piggyback_get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for CoAP resources, responds with a text payload containing request info.

methods.name: test_del
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests, responds with a deletion acknowledgment.

methods.name: test_put
methods.description: Handles PUT requests, logs payload if present, responds with change acknowledgment.

methods.name: test_post
methods.description: Handles POST requests, responds with created status and location options.
